evan (devex): Heads-up: onboarding sample app created duplicate invoices when token rotated mid-submit. Quick repro and looking for a minimal safe-replay pattern we can bake into the JS SDK.

priya (sdk): ugh. short Q: where do you save state and what do you replay?

ev an (devex): we were saving full request body in localStorage and re-POSTing on reload: `localStorage.pending = JSON.stringify(req)`.

hugo (platform): that's the issue. If original finishes after a refresh you can double-create. Timeline: POST -> auth refresh -> client replay -> original returns 201 -> replay returns 201.

priya (sdk): proposed minimum pattern for docs: 1) persist only `{idempotencyKey, endpoint, resourceHint}` 2) on resume call lightweight `HEAD /idemp/:key` or `GET /resource/status` 3) treat 202 as in-flight and poll instead of blind re-POST 4) subscribe to `auth:refresh` events and wait a short grace window (eg 1500ms) before replay.

ev an (devex): can SDK expose a helper? would save copy/paste across samples.

priya (sdk): yes, we'll add `sdk.resumeSafely(pending)` implementing that flow and emitting hooks for auth events. Also doc the risk if backend lacks idempotency lookup: in that case pause + backoff + new key is best-effort.

hugo (platform): server note: recommend client-scoped keys like `clientId:key` and a documented dedupe window. Also accept `X-Original-Idempotency: <old>` header to help dedupe on recreate.

ops-bot: CI: sampleapps/onboarding #778 queued tests :runner:

ev an (devex): thanks — I'll update sampleapp to stop persisting bodies, wire the helper, add an e2e that simulates token rotation and tag the PR "sdk-idempotency".

priya (sdk): great, will draft a short quickstart snippet and small RFC for the helper.

ev an (devex): awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
